## Activity

During January 2019, Central Eye Clinic recorded 170 captures. This report summarises the activity completed during the month, together with the quality of the images received and the outcome of grading. The recorded activity provides the basis for monitoring the site’s operational performance and identifying any issues requiring follow-up. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.

## Image quality

Of the 170 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2. These images could not be used for grading, and the result is recorded separately from the graded activity. The image-quality information should be considered when reviewing the overall performance for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 26 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 10 days. This records the typical time between the image being captured and the grading outcome being available. The grading results and the median lag should be reviewed alongside the activity and image-quality figures to support routine service monitoring. Overall, the report records the number of captures completed, the small number of ungradable images, the referable results identified, and the time taken to reach grading outcomes.
